reviews.t: Exactly what I have been looking for!
reviews.x: I have finally found the perfect flat iron for my bangs.  The Milantia Mini Hair Straightener 3/4" Ceramic Tourmaline Ionic Flat Iron heats up fast to take care of my half curly bangs that have a mind of their own.   I have coarse thick hair, but my bangs have thinned with age and have started developing weird curls and cowlicks. It's the only part of my hair that needs the nuclear option because I keep the rest of it braised most of the time.  I don't have time for a lot of hair care, and this

we bought this mini iron for my mother in law.  She has short hair (longer than a man's haircut) and wanted something small.  This iron is perfect for this hair length.  It heats up super fast.  great grip on the hair.  Best of all great value for the cost.
I had low expectations, given the size and the price, but figured it was worth the cost to take a chance. I was delighted to discover it is terrific. It does exactly what I need it to do.

I like the size of the iron as I have shorter hair. I also have arthritis in my hands so the size works well. The only things I don't care for is the stiffness of the cord and where the on/off switch is. I keep shutting it off because that switch is right under my fingers.My former iron had the switch between the handles.

This gets super hot, very quickly! Do not leave on your hair for more than 5 seconds per run, it should be like brushing your hair. Wish there was a temp control but it's small product, kind of asking a lot.

reviews.t: Perfect size for travel or home!
reviews.x: I love that this is dual voltage. I visit family in Germany and I won't need to have two separate irons now. It even has the plug adaptor.  It takes about 30 seconds to heat up after you turn it on. It does not have multiple heat settings, just on/off. The cord is nice and long so you can turn around and look in the mirror or whatever and not be stuck. I use it to tame some of the more stubborn parts of my mohawk that don't always want to stick up the right way. There's a velcro strap to keep th

reviews.t: Perfect for my purse, the office and camping.
reviews.x: I straighten my hair daily. This mini straightener is perfect for camping and on the go. I actually got this to keep at the office for emergencies but I'll be taking it with me when I go camping too. Due to the smaller size it takes a little longer to straighten my hair. This isn't ideal for every day use unless you have really short hair, but it works great in a pinch or when you are trying to pack light. It comes with a pretty blue green travel case/bag. It has dual voltage 100-240V and an ada

I have medium length hair with layers, the large flat irons just did not give me the curl or body I was looking for...fast forward to this product and I AM IN LOVE! It has surpassed my expectations ...lots of bouncy curls, or just a little body, or straight with body...It does it all!!!!

This works well for my hair which is thinning and straight. It takes a few try to remember to hold it shut. I'm used to using a curling iron which clamps down and stays. I would definitely recommend the Mini Hair Straightener / Flat Iron for Bang and Short Hair,

I do not use this for its normal intended purpose, but it worked perfectly for sealing my foil samples for my small business. I was pleasantly surprised at how well this did! It heated up quickly and was very easy to use with one hand.

reviews.t: May not be good for fine hair
reviews.x: Like the small size , and the heat strength...........when hair is clamped between iron, it doesn't stay , falls out , no matter how much or how little section of hair is......
Like the size of it works good for traveling. Like how it heated up quickly.
La compré para el flequillo y esta perfecta me encanto
This is a great little hair straightener however when I close it and then open it my finger has gotten pinched several times.

reviews.t: Its good for the price and easy to carry..
reviews.x: You can use it either way. If curing it takes a few tries to get use to it not stay tight like a curling iron. Also, if you have thin hair it tends to slip through so you may want to use more hair. It can be used for both.. if you have short hair it curls it really nice. Long hair it’s good for also.. I love it.. it was a good purchase.

I recently cut my hair very short and was having trouble styling it with my big bulky flat iron. This small lightweight flat iron was perfect. It heats up quickly, works well, and is perfect for traveling. Even comes with a travel bag.
Super tiny doesnt have a choose to adjust heat it's either on or off and it pulls my hair really bad when using it.
I really like it! My only thing is no heat controls but that could have been mentioned and I just didn't see it

I used these flatirons for my daughter’s hair. It got her roots good but her actual hair was still frizzy. They do get hot but not hot enough. Definitely not for thick hair. More so for naturally thin or non-frizzy hair. I originally bought them for my vacation coming up but now that I’ve finally used them, there’s no point in bringing them because they won’t get the job done. I honestly want to return them because they’re not good enough for any of our hair in my home. We have no use for them.

I bought this back in 2020 and finally had to take it out of the country with me but ended up leaving it in a hotel room in orlando. I was so upset, this is the best little hair straightener I have ever had for on the go. I have thin wavy-ish hair so this was the perfect little tool for me. I have tried all over South America to find one that was as good/better that this and I have always come up short. My first purchase when I get back to the states for sure.

Awesome little hair straightener.  I have long hair (mid back) and slightly curly.  Of course the larger one is quicker but for quick trips and wanting to pack light this is perfect.  It doesn’t have auto shut off but that doesn’t bother me.  I don’t think it’s any hotter then the temp I use on my larger one.  It has a case which is great when you have to pack it away almost right after using.  Check it out!

Very small which I love, you would think it being so small that it wouldn’t work well but I was shocked at how well it really worked. It really straightened my hair really well, I have medium  length hair which is pretty course with lots of body in it and it worked well with my hair type. Has only one temperature, which is on or off. I Bought it to take on a trip with me, it’s prefect for that.

I don't know if its me or the product but I find it hard to use and the button is in a spot where it gets turned off a lot. When I can get it where I want it ....it does work but just not how I thought it would. So I give it 4 stars since I obviously am not going to blame the product unless I know its the products fault. It is of good quality for being so small and its great for traveling.

Like the "Milantia Mini Hair Straightener, 3/4 Inch Travel Mini Flat Iron for Short Hair and Bangs" but missing what I would have liked:  1) once hair in, you have to hold it shut..doesn't have a way to keep it closed. Anyone with hand problems might have difficulty with this.  2) Thought it would be hotter than it is. 3) The cord does not rotate so it tends to get tangled up.

I love how well this fits in my purse, for on the go styling, travel or mini road trips. So excited to have found this as someone with very thick wavy hair I can take this anywhere with me, it also comes with a European adapter which I love!!!!! and a cute teal bag to carry it around in. Absolutely perfect very happy that I finally ordered it!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise how quickly the mini flat iron heats up.
Many customers find the small size ideal for short hair, bangs, travel, and on-the-go use.
Several reviewers note the iron lacks temperature control and gets very hot, requiring caution.
Some users report the clamp doesn't hold hair well, especially with fine or thin hair.
A few reviewers mention design drawbacks like finger pinching and an awkwardly placed on/off switch.
